name: P18 Intent and Safety Benchmark
description: Versioned, human-labeled holdout benchmark expanded deterministically from distinct intent, ambiguity, unsupported, malformed, and adversarial prompts. Prefix/suffix contexts are fixed and documented; examples are not used to train the classifier.
